authorization: 사용자가 양자 고유 이점을 겨냥한 약 10개 방법을 스모크 테스트하고 이점이 있는 방법을 전체 실험으로 실행·보고하도록 요청했다.
class_weight: balanced, fixed in every kernel SVC; no weight-grid selection this round

alignment.fit_scope: Stratified training-only sample; no tune/gate/test labels; budget exhaustion recorded, not claimed convergence

smoke: Full training-fitted PCA/LR caches, stratified training cap2048. Original validation10% split stratified into tune/gate halves with seed+1717. Candidate inputs contain y_train/y_tune but no y_gate or test arrays. Every method/arm/lambda/C choice and strongest classical choice locked on tune5FN+FP before gate label access. No gate-based parameter reselection.
full: Every promoted method evaluated on all four full datasets and common ten seeds, not just the favorable dataset. Train80/validation10/test10. Single SVC fitted once on all training80 for each candidate, no ensemble/calibration/refit. All positive 0.05-spaced lambdas, test scores from same fit, choices locked before test labels in reporting. Preserve original six model categories as separately named unclipped reference controls.

promotion.definition: Global track: equal-dataset mean criteria plus quantum beats best classical on at least3/4 datasets. Dataset-limited track: same effect thresholds on all5 paired seeds for one prespecified method/dataset and >=4/5 wins both vs own baseline and best classical. All specificity values must be positive. Zero denominators forbid promotion for that scope, never discard a seed. Promote every method passing either track, then full-run all four datasets. These are exploratory practical gates over10 global+40 dataset scopes, not significance or proof of quantum advantage; report all failures and do not relax gates.

comparators: Classical RBF on raw/scaled angles, risk-appended, LR-directed shift, risk-polynomial expansion and training-aligned RBF. RF and XGBoost on shared seven PCA coordinates with and without LR rank; standalone LR risk. All use same information, splits and tune-only selection. Classical search is intentionally broader; do not claim equal search budget. Raw-feature production-grade classical benchmark is not established by this shared-PCA smoke.
ablations: Every method has lambda0 no-risk baseline, no-entangling counterpart and independently shuffled train/tune/evaluation LR-rank counterpart. Risk direction/feature weights from original training LR cache. Exact simulator statevectors; projected and local-HS kernels are classical processing of quantum observables, multiscale is a PSD mixture, not all methods are one pure-state circuit kernel.
statistics: Smoke: descriptive same-seed gate deltas, no significance claim from five repeated splits. Full: seed cost directions, paired cost delta, approximate corrected repeated-holdout95%CI/raw p; Holm over all promoted-method*dataset contrasts (Q within, Q versus best classical, Q versus separable, Q versus shuffled, Q-minus-RBF risk interaction, RBF within). Lambda profiles are a separate exploratory family. Post-selection and earlier use of these source datasets remain disclosed.
execution: Smoke12 workers, full4 workers, BLAS/Aer1 thread, exact CPU double7/8-qubit statevectors, no QPU/shots/noise/GPU acceleration. No theorem-level or computational quantum advantage can be inferred from these small classically simulated circuits. Preserve FICO and all old sources/results. No automatic failed-run retry or reboot restart.
